_schema.PROCESS_NAME: string (required) - process whose action items are searched
_schema.SUBPROCESS_NAME: string (required) - subprocess used for subprocess-raised items
_schema.UNKNOWN_PROCESS_NAME: string (required) - process name that does not exist
_schema.STATUS_NOT_STARTED: string (required) - display value of status code 0 in this environment
_schema.PAGE_NUMBER_PAST_END: number (required) - page number beyond the last page
_schema.ATTRIBUTE_FILTER: object (required) - PSR 'Action Items Attribute Search' filter (code lists)
_schema.EXCLUDING_STATUS_FILTER: object (required) - status filter that excludes Not Started items
_schema.ITEM_REQUIRED_KEYS: string[] (required) - keys every search item must carry
_schema.PO_INVALID_REQUEST_ERROR_CODE: string (required) - PO errorCode for a hierarchy retrieval error
_schema.INVALID_JSON_ERROR_CODE: string (required) - errorCode for a malformed JSON body
_schema.PROCESS_ACTION_ITEM: object (required) - create body for a process action item; name, entityId, sourceId and origin are set at runtime
_schema.SUBPROCESS_ACTION_ITEM: object (required) - create body for a subprocess action item; name and entityId are set at runtime
